_comment: PREPARED 10-25 (not run): M1 = Maya v1.1.28 with Strata v0.2.6's arithmetic - prompt skip off, FAT_ROWS off, ATTN_MMA off, slabs 8/16 MB (Strata's fixed sizes), IQ_Q8K off (q8_1 per 32), PCIe lane off, slot keep off, chunk 8192, DS4_SPLIT 10,30 with the 4060 Ti first, 6 experts (the pack's ds4.txt; no flag), no DSpark, experts in place (--mmap-experts on: never copied). DS4_CACHE_THREADS 1 = Strata's default (Maya's is 4 on 2 GPUs) - drop it if M1 should keep Maya's cache threads. Lossy switches unset: DS4_YOCO_KEEP, MAYA_DS4_DISK_SKIP_W, MAYA_DS4_RAM_SKIP_W, DS4_INDEX_TC. Paths (exe, cwd, pack) are proposals until the build.
